ml3_agglomerative_steps.source: Seven hand-placed points; scipy linkage(method="ward"). Merge numbers are the order of the rows of the linkage matrix.

ml3_bic_curve.source: Same synthetic data as the covariance-type figure (three generating components, seed 17); GaussianMixture(covariance_type="full", n_init=5, random_state=0) for K = 1-8.

ml3_components_vs_groups.source: Synthetic: a curved group and a log-normal (skewed) group, seed 23. GaussianMixture(full, n_init=5, random_state=0); ellipses at 1.5 standard deviations.

ml3_contingency.source: Synthetic well S-1 (seed 7): reference lithology versus KMeans(K=5, n_init=10, random_state=0) on standardized logs; counts of depth samples.

ml3_cov_types.source: Synthetic three-component data (seed 17); GaussianMixture(K=3, n_init=5, random_state=0) with each covariance_type; ellipses at 1 and 2 standard deviations.

ml3_dbscan_chain.source: Synthetic two moons (make_moons, 230 points, noise 0.065, random_state=42) plus three hand-placed outliers; DBSCAN(eps=0.2, min_samples=8). Discs: eps-neighbourhoods of a chain of core points.

ml3_dbscan_concept.source: Hand-placed points; types computed with DBSCAN(eps=1.0, min_samples=4).

ml3_dendrogram_basic.source: Twelve synthetic points from three blobs (make_blobs random_state=42); scipy Ward linkage; colours mark the three clusters below the cut at height 3.

ml3_dendrogram_cut.source: Synthetic 34 points from four blobs (random_state=1); scipy Ward linkage; cuts halfway between merge heights; fcluster(maxclust).

ml3_depth_tracks.source: Synthetic well S-1 (seed 7): KMeans(K=4) on standardized GR, RHOB, NPHI, log10 RT; per-sample silhouette from sklearn; "core lithology" is the simulation truth.

ml3_em_iterations.source: Synthetic three-component data (seed 31). EM for a full-covariance Gaussian mixture written in numpy from a deliberately poor start; point colour mixes component colours by responsibility.

ml3_energy_uses.source: Synthetic data: well S-1 (seed 7) k-means K=4 and depth-constrained Ward; Arps-type decline curves (seed 3) k-means K=3; ESP regimes (seed 5) Gaussian mixture K=3.

ml3_eps_panels.source: Same synthetic data as the k-distance plot; DBSCAN(min_samples=5) at three eps values. Grey crosses are noise.

ml3_feature_weights.source: Synthetic four-group data, seed 8, standardized; KMeans(K=2) after multiplying feature 2 by the stated weight; plotted in unweighted coordinates.

ml3_gmm_soft.source: Two synthetic overlapping bivariate normal groups of 150 points (numpy seed 42); GaussianMixture(2, n_init=5, random_state=42); colour = predict_proba for component 1.

ml3_gmm_uncertainty.source: Synthetic overlapping groups (seed 41); GaussianMixture(K=3, full, n_init=5, random_state=0). 2-SD ellipses of the fitted components.

ml3_hdbscan_vs_dbscan.source: Synthetic dense, medium and sparse groups plus uniform background (seed 14); scikit-learn DBSCAN(min_samples=10) and HDBSCAN(min_cluster_size=20). Grey crosses are noise.

ml3_internal_indices.source: Synthetic five blobs with two close pairs (make_blobs random_state=0); KMeans(n_init=10, random_state=0) for K = 2-8; scikit-learn metric implementations.

ml3_kdistance.source: Synthetic moons (random_state=3) plus 28 uniform noise points; NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5) on the training points, so each point counts itself, as DBSCAN min_samples does.

ml3_kmeans_failures.source: Synthetic data after the scikit-learn k-means assumptions example (make_blobs random_state=170; unequal sizes numpy seed 3). KMeans(K=3, n_init=10). Dashed ellipses: generating groups, 90% coverage. Share computed after best label matching.

ml3_kmeans_steps.source: Synthetic three blobs (make_blobs, 150 points, random_state=42); one Lloyd iteration from fixed starting centres (-2.5, 1.8), (0.2, 0.5), (2.8, 1.6). Hollow crosses in the middle panel mark the starting centres.

ml3_kmeanspp.source: Synthetic four-blob data (random_state=2). One textbook k-means++ draw (D² sampling, numpy seed 0) and one uniform draw (seed 0). One seed in every blob: 66% of 2,000 textbook k-means++ draws (numpy seed 0), 95% of 2,000 scikit-learn kmeans_plusplus draws (random_state 0-1999); uniform sampling of four distinct points 9.5% (exact).

ml3_linkage_compare.source: Synthetic: two dense blobs joined by a 14-point bridge plus an elongated third group (seed 5); AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=3) with each linkage.

ml3_linkage_defs.source: Two hand-placed five-point groups; distances computed exactly. Ward: increase in the within-cluster sum of squares if the groups merge (dashed = distances to the merged centroid).

ml3_method_flow.source: Schematic method shortlist; a starting point, not a rule.

ml3_mixture_1d.source: Exact two-component normal mixture (weights 0.4/0.6, means 45/100 API, SD 12/14 API) with a 700-sample synthetic histogram (seed 9).

ml3_optics.source: Same synthetic data as the HDBSCAN comparison; OPTICS(min_samples=30, xi=0.03). Bars are coloured by the extracted cluster; grey = noise. A horizontal cut reproduces DBSCAN at that eps.

ml3_profile_heatmap.source: Synthetic well S-1 (seed 7): KMeans(K=4) on standardized logs. Cells show cluster means in original units (RT as geometric mean); colour = standardized mean, blue above and orange below the well average.

ml3_profiles_warmup.source: Synthetic decline curves: A hyperbolic (qi=300, Di=0.25/month, b=0.8); B = 3 x A; C plateau at 170 for 14 months then exponential decline 0.10/month.

ml3_restarts.source: Synthetic 3 x 3 blob grid (make_blobs random_state=7, 495 points). Lloyd iterations from 20 uniform random starts (numpy seeds 100-119), K=9, 25 iterations each.

ml3_scaling_effect.source: Synthetic GR and RHOB samples of three lithologies, seed 4; KMeans(K=3, n_init=10, random_state=0) on raw and on standardized features; cluster colours matched to the reference.

ml3_silhouette_geometry.source: Synthetic three-cluster example (seed 21); a, b and s computed with numpy and checked against sklearn silhouette_samples.

ml3_silhouette_knife.source: Synthetic three-blob data (random_state=5); KMeans(n_init=10, random_state=0) with K=3 and K=5; per-sample values from sklearn silhouette_samples.

ml3_stability.source: Synthetic well S-1 (seed 7), standardized logs. For each K, KMeans refitted on 30 bootstrap resamples (numpy seed 0), labels predicted for all samples and compared with the full-data fit.

ml3_structureless.source: Synthetic: 500 draws from one standard bivariate normal, seed 11; KMeans(K=4, n_init=10, random_state=0).

ml3_voronoi.source: Synthetic blobs (make_blobs, random_state=6), standardized; KMeans(K=5). Shading = nearest-centroid (Voronoi) cells.

ml3_w5_debrief.source: Computed from w5.csv (course data, 7,071 samples): KMeans(n_init=10, random_state=42) on six standardized features as in the Lab 1 notebook; K=3 clusters plotted against depth.

ml3_zonation.source: Synthetic well S-1 (seed 7): Ward clustering of standardized GR, RHOB, NPHI and log10 RT; unconstrained K=4, and with a connectivity matrix linking adjacent samples (cuts at 6 and 16 zones).
